seed_materials.title: Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models
seed_materials.abstract: DreamerV3 learns a model of the environment and improves its behavior by imagining future trajectories across many domains with fixed hyperparameters.

seed_materials.title: Genie: Generative Interactive Environments
seed_materials.abstract: Genie learns a generative interactive environment from unlabeled Internet videos, enabling action-controllable virtual worlds.

seed_materials.title: Learning Universal Policies via Text-Guided Video Generation
seed_materials.abstract: UniPi casts sequential decision making as text-conditioned video generation, then infers actions from generated frames.

seed_materials.title: Diffusion for World Modeling: Visual Details Matter in Atari
seed_materials.abstract: DIAMOND is a diffusion-based world model arguing that high-fidelity visual detail improves imagined rollouts used for planning.

seed_materials.title: GAIA-1: A Generative World Model for Autonomous Driving
seed_materials.abstract: GAIA-1 generates realistic driving scenarios from video, text, and action inputs for autonomous-driving world modeling.

seed_materials.title: Cosmos World Foundation Model Platform for Physical AI
seed_materials.abstract: NVIDIA Cosmos presents world foundation models aimed at Physical AI and embodied simulation workflows.

seed_materials.title: Video generation models as world simulators
seed_materials.abstract: OpenAI technical note introducing Sora and arguing video generation models are progressing toward general-purpose world simulators.

seed_materials.title: Diffusion Models Are Real-Time Game Engines
seed_materials.abstract: GameNGen shows a neural model can simulate DOOM in real time via diffusion, testing generative dynamics as interactive engines.

seed_materials.title: VideoPoet: A Large Language Model for Zero-Shot Video Generation
seed_materials.abstract: VideoPoet is a language-model approach to zero-shot video generation — a media-generation reference class versus planner/simulator systems.

seed_materials.venue: PhD Dissertation, University of Rhode Island
seed_materials.abstract: Doctoral dissertation on trust-region policy optimization for sample-efficient reinforcement learning, adjacent background for world-model control methods.
